name: Remote control
author: Rona
description: Lets programs on this computer pause, play and seek in Rona. They send commands like toggle, next or seek through Rona's plugin pipe, or with rona --plugin-send.

permissions.ipc.serve: Takes commands from programs on this computer
permissions.playback.control: Pauses, plays and seeks when asked
permissions.media.metadata: Answers with the title of what plays
